description: Reviewed npm audit exceptions, read by release/scripts/npm-audit-with-exceptions.mjs. Only the infra/aws audit steps in .github/workflows/tuf-local-gates.yml and tuf-publish.yml use it; every other npm audit runs plain npm audit --audit-level=moderate. An entry covers one advisory in one package, at npm's exact vulnerable range, severity and installed paths, in one audited directory, until expires_at (00:00 UTC). An uncovered advisory, an expired entry or a stale entry fails the audit. See docs/TUF-CI-PROTECTION.md.

exceptions.justification: Denial of service through crafted glob patterns (globparts amplification, CWE-405). This minimatch (10.2.5) is bundled inside aws-cdk-lib 2.273.0 and runs only while CDK synthesizes infra/aws, in three places: asset exclude patterns (IgnoreStrategy), the bundling-stacks context patterns (Stack.bundlingRequired) and construct-id selectors. The patterns come from this repository's source and CDK context, and the strings matched are this repository's construct paths and asset file paths, so no outside input reaches minimatch. infra/aws is not copied into any runtime image, its node_modules are not in the TUF publication tooling archive, and its one Lambda asset (runtime/workload-issuer) is two source files with no CDK code. The worst case is a slow synth on a developer or CI machine.
exceptions.fix_status: No fix available. aws-cdk-lib 2.273.0 (pinned), 2.274.0 and 2.275.0 (latest on 2026-11-01) bundle minimatch ^10.2.5 or ^10.2.6, below the fixed 11.0.1, and npm overrides cannot replace a bundled dependency. Remove this entry when infra/aws moves to an aws-cdk-lib release that bundles minimatch 11.0.1 or later.
